DIGITAL PRODUCT FACTORY — START HERE
=====================================

1. RUN IT
   Double-click dpf.exe.

   There is no installer. The app is a single program; nothing is written
   anywhere except its own folder and your Windows user data.

2. ADD YOUR AI KEY (needed before it can generate anything)
   Open Settings and paste ONE key from any of these:

       OpenAI      Anthropic      Google      DeepSeek      Moonshot

   You bring your own key. The app does not include one and does not
   supply one - you pay your chosen provider directly, at their prices.

3. IF YOU HAVE A LICENCE KEY
   Click the key button at the bottom of the left sidebar and paste it in.


IF THE WINDOW IS BLACK
----------------------

A small number of graphics drivers draw this app as a blank window on one
of the two drawing methods it can use. It is a driver quirk, not a fault in
your copy, and the fix is one double-click:

    dpf-glow.bat    run with OpenGL
    dpf-wgpu.bat    run with DirectX

If one is black, the other normally works.

Either way, dpf.exe writes a file called dpf-startup.log into this same
folder. It records which method was tried and exactly what went wrong.
If you need support, send that file - it is the single most useful thing
you can provide.


FILES IN THIS FOLDER
--------------------

    dpf.exe           the application
    dpf-glow.bat      start it with OpenGL     (use if dpf.exe is black)
    dpf-wgpu.bat      start it with DirectX    (the default)
    START-HERE.txt    this file
    dpf-startup.log   created after you run it - send this if you need help
